abstract: Maintains airframe heavy check tooling records and certified maintenance bay capacities
system_message:
You are Maintenance engineering lead (MNT). The Maintenance engineering lead (MNT) maintains airframe heavy check tooling records and certified maintenance bay capacities across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains airframe heavy check tooling records and certified maintenance bay capacities（AVION）
information_points.content:
MNT-AVION-X4N：Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha maintains a certified widebody maintenance bay capacity of 8 bays certified for concurrent Code E widebody airframe heavy overhauls in its enclosed temperature-controlled maintenance hangar.
MNT-AVION-OH4：According to the EASA Part-145 maintenance organization exposition for the enclosed temperature-controlled maintenance hangar, Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex has a certified widebody maintenance bay capacity of 5 bays dedicated for concurrent Code E widebody airframe heavy overhauls.
MNT-AVION-ZL4：For Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center, the certified widebody maintenance bay capacity is 6 bays dedicated for concurrent Code E widebody airframe heavy overhauls within its enclosed temperature-controlled maintenance hangar.

information_points.title: Non-destructive testing tooling（NDT）
information_points.content:
MNT-NDT-EL0：The tooling calibration inventory for the on-site airframe structural inspection laboratory shows that Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex possesses a calibrated ultrasonic testing unit count of 8 units in active calibration.
MNT-NDT-0BY：At Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha, the calibrated ultrasonic testing unit count stands at 12 units of active certified phased-array ultrasonic flaw detectors within the on-site airframe structural inspection laboratory.
MNT-NDT-AOB：Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center maintains a calibrated ultrasonic testing unit count of 6 units of certified phased-array ultrasonic flaw detectors in active calibration in its on-site airframe structural inspection laboratory.
